_how_to: Questionnaire fixture labels (10 Oct, written by Claude at Lina's request; not independent of the document's design). Same scope rules as Harbour Bank. Excluded by design: row 8 customer obligation, row 9 pointer, row 10 bare 'Yes.' (known limitation, unlabelled). 8 statements, 7 firm.

statements.speaker: Elva (questionnaire)
statements.quote: Elva supports SAML 2.0 single sign-on for all Kestrel Remit users from go-live.

statements.speaker: Elva (questionnaire)
statements.quote: Elva will enforce multi-factor authentication for every Kestrel Remit administrator account.

statements.speaker: Elva (questionnaire)
statements.quote: All Kestrel Remit data will be encrypted at rest with AES-256.

statements.speaker: Elva (questionnaire)
statements.quote: Kestrel Remit data will be stored and processed only in Singapore.

statements.speaker: Elva (questionnaire)
statements.quote: Elva is working towards SOC 2 Type II and expects the report in the second half of 2027.

statements.speaker: Elva (questionnaire)
statements.quote: An independent penetration test is performed every year, and Elva will share the executive summary with Kestrel Remit on request.

statements.speaker: Elva (questionnaire)
statements.quote: Elva will screen every NUSD payout on Arbitrum in real time before release.

statements.speaker: Elva (questionnaire)
statements.quote: Elva provides full case audit history for every alert raised on Kestrel Remit payouts.
